source.notes: CISCE item bank of Competency-Focused Practice Questions for ISC Class XII Mathematics (preface signed August 2024 by the Chief Executive & Secretary; file published on cisce.org in April 2025). It is a practice bank, not an examination paper: no maximum marks, duration or examination year are printed, so examYear, maxMarks and durationMinutes are null; the session label reflects the August 2024 preface. 134 questions in seven sections, each section header printing its marks: I Multiple Choice (Q1-26), II Statement Based (Q27-35), III Assertion-Reason (Q36-45) and IV Very Short Answer (Q46-70) at 1 mark each; V Short Answer (Q71-92) 2 marks each; VI Long Answer (Q93-124) 4 marks each; VII Very Long Answer (Q125-134) 6 marks each (marksSource SECTION_INSTRUCTIONS). Multi-part questions (a), (b)... share one stem and are kept as one entry at the section mark. Physical PDF pages: 1-2 preface and front matter, 3 table of contents, questions on pages 4-46 (printed page number + 3), Answer Key ('Expected Answers') on pages 47-82, back cover page 83. Each question's printed topic tag (e.g. [Matrices]) was used for the chapter suggestion; each printed cognitive-domain tag (e.g. '(Analysis & Application)') is recorded as cognitiveLevel exactly as printed. Official answers are copied from the bank's own Answer Key for the same question number, which the preface says 'presents the possible answers to a given question, but it is neither limiting nor exhaustive'; they are never extended. The text layer duplicates Cambria Math glyphs (e.g. 'xx' for x) and scatters fractions, powers, roots, integrals, matrices and determinants across lines; math-italic letters were normalised and every such expression was rebuilt from the rendered page (flagged, MEDIUM), with matrices/determinants written as [row1; row2; row3] / |row1; row2; row3| and definite-integral limits as ∫ₐᵇ or ∫_(lower)^(upper). Topics 'Application of Calculus' (economics: cost, revenue, break-even) and 'Linear Regression' belong to the ISC Section C syllabus, which has no chapter in the current list, so those questions have chapter null. Figures, graphs and photographs are not reproduced; where a question depends on one, hasFigure is true and confidence LOW.
